intervals.label: decommissioned
intervals.note: The CONUS experiment's own setup at this site continued taking background(-only) data for some time after the reactor's own shutdown, before physically relocating to Leibstadt in 2023 (see experiment:conus); this interval describes the reactor/facility itself, not the CONUS detector's own operating window.

name: Brokdorf Nuclear Power Plant
notes: Created by the cevns workstream (ID_REGISTRY Wave 3) as the original host facility of the CONUS experiment (2018-2023); operated as CONUS+ at facility:leibstadt-nuclear-power-plant from late 2023.

Reactor thermal power (3.9 GWth, per arXiv:2011.00210) is not recorded as a `specs` quantity: the only Appendix A power-dimension spec key is `beam_power`, whose A21 plausibility range (1 kW-10 MW) is built for accelerator beamlines and rejects a gigawatt-scale reactor core; the figure is given in prose in `summary.technical` instead.

summary.plain: A now-closed German nuclear power plant on the Elbe river that hosted the CONUS reactor-neutrino experiment from 2018 until the setup moved to Switzerland in 2023.
summary.technical: Brokdorf Nuclear Power Plant (KBR), Schleswig-Holstein, Germany; 3.9 GWth / 1440 MWe boiling water reactor, shut down 2021-12-31 as part of Germany's nuclear phase-out; hosted the CONUS CEvNS experiment 17.1 m from the reactor core.
